nodes.label: Reset keeps saving pots, folds balance onto opening_amount
nodes.rationale: reset_restaurant_finance's established shape is keep the account, delete its transactions, carry the balance onto an opening term — the same pattern as products.opening_stock and vendors.opening_credit.

nodes.label: delete_restaurant_cascade names extra_expenses/saving_titles explicitly
nodes.rationale: Two ON DELETE cascades whose relative order Postgres does not promise; naming them explicitly avoids depending on RI trigger name sort order, which breaks on a database rebuilt from scratch.

nodes.label: Emptied saving pot is CLOSED, not deleted
nodes.rationale: A saving row IS an extra_expenses row already counted by a dated report; deleting it would silently rewrite a settled day's closing cash, which on delete restrict exists to prevent.

nodes.label: Unit-wise cancellation: counters + event log, both
nodes.rationale: The counter exists because PostgREST cannot aggregate a child table into an embed; the event log exists because stock_report dates a release by timestamp and one cancelled_at cannot date two partial cancellations.

nodes.label: cancelled_at still means the WHOLE line is gone
nodes.rationale: Stamped only when cancelled_quantity = quantity; redefining fully done as cancelled+served=quantity would silently stop bill numbers being released.

nodes.label: Releases got their OWN view, order_item_release
nodes.rationale: Emitting release legs from order_item_consumption would fan out N times and corrupt product_history's running balance; the new view joins the old rather than re-deriving the recipe rule.

nodes.label: Partial cancellation refused not clamped; CAS not a key
nodes.rationale: A retry of cancel 2 would cancel two MORE under per-unit events; CAS on the remaining count needs no client state and also covers two cashiers cancelling concurrently.

nodes.label: Cancelling an item on a PAID bill is refused
nodes.rationale: No refund/adjustment concept exists; getPaidBill re-queries items live so a post-payment cancel silently changed a printed bill while total_amount stayed frozen.

nodes.label: Derived stock, not cached
nodes.rationale: No current_stock column; a cache drifts from the POS but a derived figure can't. No nightly rollover job needed.

nodes.label: Four derived balances
nodes.rationale: Cash, online, credit-to-us, credit-by-us are all derived by finance_report; only the opening seed is stored, so carry-forward can never drift.

nodes.label: Security PIN: in-place edit + audit, not reversal
nodes.rationale: Finance and stock are already derived from payments/purchase_items, so an edited row re-derives correctly; void semantics would mean new bill/void numbers and teaching every report to net voids.

nodes.label: Self-hosted migration: replay migrations, copy data over Kong
nodes.rationale: Reach the DB through postgres-meta at Kong's /pg/query rather than SSH/exposed port; replay 72 migrations rather than pg_dump to avoid version skew; copy bcrypt hashes directly for logins.

nodes.label: Enum ADD VALUE and its first use cannot share a migration
nodes.rationale: Postgres rejects using a new enum value in the same transaction it was added in (55P04); baselining had hidden this bug because the file was recorded as applied without running.

nodes.label: Mock bills write NOTHING, structurally enforced
nodes.rationale: No mock_bills tables; every app figure derives from payments/session_order_items/purchases/stock_adjustments, so a row never written is invisible to all of them by construction.

nodes.label: Two Supabase projects (dev/prod)
nodes.rationale: .env.local = DEV, .env.production = prod, to isolate real data. Never append to an env file without a trailing newline.

nodes.label: Self-hosted cutover complete 2026-08-27
nodes.rationale: The droplet (.env.hrestrosewa) is the only live database now; .env.production was never the live target and was renamed to .env.production(supabase) to prevent future confusion.

nodes.label: Assignment is single source of truth for dashboard visibility
nodes.rationale: viewerSeesAllGroups returns true only for restaurant_admin; capability perms gate WHAT you may do but no longer WIDEN what you can see or touch.

nodes.label: A product's workstation is metadata, not mechanism
nodes.rationale: product_workstations is a nullable M2M with on delete cascade — a product with no station is ordinary, unlike menu items where the station is trigger-enforced and required.
